theme.en: AI infrastructure broadens beyond the accelerator
theme.zh: AI基础设施扩展到加速器之外

dek.en: Today’s moves span rack-scale accelerators, memory interfaces, a 2nm production target, and chemicals supply. The common constraint is no longer a single chip: performance depends on the stack around it.
dek.zh: 今日动态涵盖机架级加速器、存储接口、2nm产能目标和化学材料供应。共同的约束已不再是一颗芯片，而是围绕芯片的整套技术栈。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD details a 72-accelerator Helios rack-scale system
title.zh: AMD详解由72颗加速器组成的Helios机架级系统

summary.en: AMD has outlined Helios, its first rack-scale system, as a configuration that makes 72 Instinct MI455X accelerators operate as one system. The design shifts attention from the accelerator card to the interconnect, networking, and software needed to keep a large rack productive.
summary.zh: AMD介绍了其首个机架级系统Helios，该配置让72颗Instinct MI455X加速器作为一个系统运行。这一设计将关注点从加速器卡本身转向互连、网络和让整机架持续高效运行的软件。

title.en: Olix raises $312 million for an optical inference appliance
title.zh: 光学推理设备厂商Olix完成3.12亿美元融资

summary.en: Optical inference appliance maker Olix has raised a $312 million round backed in part by a Netflix co-founder. The financing gives a specialized compute approach more runway, but its commercial test will be integration into production inference stacks rather than component-level demonstrations.
summary.zh: 光学推理设备厂商Olix完成3.12亿美元融资，Netflix联合创始人参与支持。这笔资金为专用计算路线提供了更长的商业化周期，但真正的考验仍是能否接入生产级推理技术栈，而非仅在组件层面演示。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC reportedly targets 100,000 N2 wafers a month by end-2026
title.zh: 报道称台积电瞄准2026年底月产10万片N2晶圆

summary.en: TSMC is reported to be targeting monthly output of 100,000 N2 wafers by the end of 2026. If reached, that ramp would make 2nm capacity a central input to the next AI and high-end mobile product cycles, while putting pressure on materials and advanced packaging supply.
summary.zh: 报道称，台积电瞄准在2026年底前实现N2晶圆月产10万片。若能达成，2nm产能将成为下一轮AI和高端移动产品周期的关键投入，也会加大对材料和先进封装供应的压力。

title.en: TSMC Kumamoto resumes production after earthquake inspection
title.zh: 台积电熊本工厂震后检查完成并恢复生产

summary.en: TSMC’s Kumamoto factory has reportedly resumed normal production six days after an earthquake inspection. The restart limits the risk of a prolonged interruption at a site that is important to Japan’s effort to add mature-node and specialty manufacturing capacity.
summary.zh: 报道称，台积电熊本工厂在地震检查六天后已恢复正常生产。此次复产降低了长期中断的风险；该厂是日本增加成熟制程和特色制造产能计划的重要组成部分。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix introduces 375-layer NAND with a 2.5x efficiency claim
title.zh: SK hynix推出375层NAND，称能效提升2.5倍

summary.en: SK hynix has unveiled a 375-layer NAND product and says it delivers 2.5 times the performance per watt. Higher layer counts can improve density, but controller behavior, yields, and qualification will decide how quickly the part changes enterprise and AI-storage deployments.
summary.zh: SK hynix推出375层NAND产品，并称其每瓦性能提升2.5倍。更高层数可提高存储密度，但控制器表现、良率和客户认证将决定该产品多快改变企业级与AI存储部署。

title.en: Renesas updates DDR5 MRDIMM for 16,000 MT/s bandwidth
title.zh: Renesas更新DDR5 MRDIMM，带宽达到16,000 MT/s

summary.en: Renesas has updated its Gen 3 DDR5 MRDIMM, positioning it for 16,000 MT/s bandwidth without a platform overhaul. The module targets a memory bottleneck in AI servers, where usable bandwidth and capacity increasingly constrain CPU and accelerator utilization.
summary.zh: Renesas更新了Gen 3 DDR5 MRDIMM，并将其定位为无需大幅改造平台即可达到16,000 MT/s带宽的方案。该模块针对AI服务器的内存瓶颈；在此场景中，可用带宽和容量日益限制CPU与加速器利用率。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Brewer Science acquires Heraeus Epurio semiconductor chemicals business
title.zh: Brewer Science收购Heraeus Epurio半导体化学品业务

summary.en: Brewer Science has acquired Heraeus Epurio’s semiconductor chemicals business to expand its U.S. supply-chain presence. Materials transactions matter because qualified process chemicals are sticky inputs: changing suppliers can require long validation cycles at a fab.
summary.zh: Brewer Science收购了Heraeus Epurio的半导体化学品业务，以扩大其在美国供应链中的布局。材料类交易之所以重要，是因为经过认证的制程化学品属于黏性投入品，晶圆厂更换供应商往往需要漫长的验证周期。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: ON Semiconductor reports an earnings and revenue beat
title.zh: ON Semiconductor业绩和营收均超预期

summary.en: ON Semiconductor reported earnings and revenue above expectations, with data-center AI demand part of the market backdrop. The result offers a read on how analog, power, and sensing suppliers participate in the AI build-out beyond the leading GPU vendors.
summary.zh: ON Semiconductor公布的盈利和营收均超过预期，数据中心AI需求构成其市场背景的一部分。这份业绩也反映出，模拟、功率和传感器供应商如何在头部GPU厂商之外参与AI基础设施建设。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 新兴挑战者

title.en: d-Matrix acquires Wallaroo.ai for heterogeneous inference deployment
title.zh: d-Matrix收购Wallaroo.ai以加快异构推理部署

summary.en: d-Matrix has acquired Wallaroo.ai to accelerate deployment of heterogeneous AI inference workloads. The deal joins specialized inference hardware with deployment software, underscoring that challengers need operational tooling as well as competitive silicon.
summary.zh: d-Matrix收购Wallaroo.ai，以加快异构AI推理工作负载的部署。该交易将专用推理硬件与部署软件结合，表明挑战者不仅需要有竞争力的芯片，也需要可运营的工具链。

theme.en: Design tools confront data movement and verification
theme.zh: 设计工具直面数据移动与验证

dek.en: This selection tests design automation against formal verification, policy selection, multi-die communication, and bandwidth-limited inference. The strongest gains come with explicit constraints rather than unconstrained code generation.
dek.zh: 本期论文将设计自动化置于形式验证、策略选择、多芯粒通信和带宽受限推理等边界条件下检验。最显著的增益来自明确约束，而非无约束的代码生成。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: Forbench: symbolic simulation for more formal testbenches
title.zh: Forbench：让测试平台更具形式化能力的符号仿真

papers.authors: Ziyi Yang, Wenbin Che, Ziyue Zheng, Guangyu Hu, Hongce Zhang

summary.en: Forbench retains a simulation-style workflow while adding solver-backed symbolic signals and state transitions to explore RTL behavior beyond sampled tests. It aims to lower the property-writing barrier to formal verification; its practical value will depend on scaling the symbolic engine to large designs.
summary.zh: Forbench保留仿真式工作流，同时加入由求解器支持的符号信号和状态转换，以探索超出抽样测试范围的RTL行为。它试图降低形式验证中的属性编写门槛，但其实用价值取决于符号引擎能否扩展到大型设计。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与体系结构

title.en: Limits of machine-learned ranking for microarchitectural policies
title.zh: 机器学习排序在微架构策略中的局限

papers.authors: Yanxin Zhang, Shayne Wadle, Yuxuan Xiong, et al.

summary.en: The authors find that ML performance predictors can rank structural hardware settings well in aggregate yet miss counter-intuitive execution windows. Such windows make up 22.4% of non-tied cases in the study, cautioning against using fast predictors as final policy selectors.
summary.zh: 作者发现，机器学习性能预测器可在总体上较好地排序硬件结构设置，却会错过反直觉的执行窗口。此类窗口占研究中非平局情形的22.4%，因此不宜把快速预测器直接作为最终策略选择器。

title.en: Dynamic selection among modern microarchitectural policies
title.zh: 现代微架构策略的动态选择

papers.authors: Yanxin Zhang, Ian McDougall, Junnan Li, et al.

summary.en: A composition study across 490 phases finds that the best global static prefetcher-and-replacement stack still trails a phase oracle by 1.33%. A selector changing only the L1D prefetcher can come within 0.039% IPC of an eight-configuration oracle, suggesting a narrow control interface.
summary.zh: 一项覆盖490个阶段的组合研究发现，最佳全局静态预取与替换策略组合仍比阶段预言机低1.33%。仅切换L1D预取器的选择器即可达到距八配置预言机0.039% IPC以内，说明可以采用范围有限的控制接口。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Zomboss: compiler-mediated kernel generation for emerging accelerators
title.zh: Zomboss：面向新兴加速器的编译器介导内核生成

papers.authors: Ruijie Gao, Jirong Yang, Barry Lyu, et al.

summary.en: Zomboss moves accelerator semantics and legality constraints into a reusable compiler artifact, leaving a neural agent to search workload-specific mappings. It returns verified kernels on all 56 Gemmini and PLENA instances and reports 3.34× geometric-mean speedup over the Gemmini compiler default.
summary.zh: Zomboss将加速器语义和合法性约束编译为可复用工件，让神经代理只搜索工作负载相关的映射。它在56个Gemmini和PLENA实例上均返回已验证内核，并报告相对Gemmini编译器默认方案3.34倍的几何平均加速。

title.en: NUNA: network locality for multi-die GPU scale-up
title.zh: NUNA：多芯粒GPU扩展中的网络局部性

papers.authors: Conor James Green, William Won, Tuan Ta, Bradford M. Beckmann

summary.en: NUNA treats physical position inside large multi-die GPU systems as a network-locality problem for collective communication. Placement plus routing achieves up to 1.8× faster collectives and a 7% mean time-per-output-token improvement in the evaluated inference workloads.
summary.zh: NUNA将大型多芯粒GPU系统中的物理位置视为集体通信的网络局部性问题。放置与路由结合后，在所评估的推理工作负载上实现最高1.8倍的集体通信加速，以及平均7%的每输出token时间改善。

title.en: CascadeLUT: streaming FPGA inference under bandwidth constraints
title.zh: CascadeLUT：带宽受限条件下的FPGA流式推理

papers.authors: Oliver Cassidy, Marta Andronic, George A. Constantinides

summary.en: CascadeLUT orders features so LUT-based FPGA models can refine predictions as data arrives instead of buffering a full sample. It reports 4.0–12.5× lower latency and up to 13.8× lower energy per sample than its LUT baselines, trading extra LUT use for less data movement.
summary.zh: CascadeLUT对特征排序，使基于查找表的FPGA模型能在数据到达时逐步优化预测，而无需缓存完整样本。它相对其LUT基线报告4.0至12.5倍更低时延及最高13.8倍更低的单样本能耗，以更多LUT资源换取更少的数据移动。
